name: Summative Assessment
description: Creates end-of-unit summative assessments with prompts, rubrics, and exemplar descriptions for educators. Produces a complete summative assessment package including the student-facing task, scoring criteria, and benchmark examples -- distinct from formative checks used during instruction. Use when an educator asks to create an end-of-unit assessment, final project, performance task, or summative evaluation for a completed unit of study. Do NOT use for in-class formative checks (use `formative-assessment`), for standalone rubrics (use `rubric-creation`), or for student exam preparation (use `exam-prep-plan`).
